_note: PROVISIONAL thresholds (openspec/specs/completion-eval), set before the first measurement. Rates are fractions; latency in ms. "tolerance" is how much worse than the baseline a compared value may get before eval:completion:check fails; tolerances must exceed run-to-run sampling noise. Criteria with "compare": false (stability, latency) are judged against their threshold only. Compared criteria report their threshold verdict but fail the gate only on a regression. After the first runs (2026-10-06): shown-agreement lowered to 0.35 (observed 0.47–0.60) and latency-p95 raised to 2000 ms (observed 955–1558 ms) so run-to-run noise never fails the gate.
